# Review - PR 488 @ 5b4ee0db62ff087cf412a4e2c52e5330b847326e

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 92b252ed4bb1860b12a0a6c96084512f53ae9e10. Main-relative change is 512 added / 118 removed lines over 14 files: seven new Lean modules building the Schwartz-Zippel collision chain for sampled lines up to a product-distribution weighted estimate, a placement-positivity refactor, one new blueprint support node, and a telemetry append.

## Findings

- [ ] F1 (code; blocker) MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/PolynomialCollision.lean:23 - this new module declares `MIPStarRE.QPBT.polynomial_ofFn_eval_eq_evalCoefficient`, which `github/main` already declares with the identical signature and proof at `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Algebra/Coefficients.lean:36`, and the module itself imports `MIPStarRE.QPBT.Algebra.Coefficients` at line 2, so as soon as the branch is refreshed onto main the same fully-qualified name is declared twice in one import closure and the module no longer elaborates; the duplicate has no call site anywhere in the branch, so delete `Lines/PolynomialCollision.lean` and import `MIPStarRE.QPBT.Algebra.Coefficients` directly in `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/UniformAffineCollision.lean:2`, exactly as main's copy of that file already does.
- [ ] F2 (code; changes) MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineUniform.lean:130 - the new `avgOver_lineRepMap_resample_parameter` is character-for-character the same statement and proof as `avgOver_uniform_lineRepMap_resample_parameter` at `github/main:MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/SubLineUniform.lean:137`, which main already uses at `Combining/ExtendedLines/Overlap.lean:115,132`, `Lines/AxisLineResampling.lean:55` and `Lines/DiagonalResampling.lean:60`; merging as-is leaves two public names for one lemma in the same file (CONTRIBUTING section 5.3, reuse over duplication), so drop the new copy and retarget `Lines/AxisLineResampling.lean:55`, `Lines/DiagonalResampling.lean:60` and the `\lean{...}` of `lem:line-representative-resampling` at `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:876` to main's name.

## Review

Scope: `base=$(git merge-base github/main 5b4ee0db)` = `8a5eddb3605b9974baf1d1c98280a809bb5e0d0e`; I read every hunk of the 14-file diff, plus the whole of each new Lean module and the changed `ConsistencyPositivity.lean`. The worktree HEAD equals the published head, so all checks ran on the reviewed sha.

Mathematics. The chain is `evalOpt_affine_parameter_of_direction_ne_zero` (uniqueness of the affine parameter on a nonzero direction) then `evalOpt_uniform_parameter_collision_le` (root count over a uniform parameter, discharged by main's `evalCoefficient_collision_card_le`, `bound` roots for `DegPoly L bound = Fin (bound+1) -> ScalarQ L`) then `linePointDist_nondegenerate_weighted_collision_le` and `prod_linePointDist_nondegenerate_weighted_collision_le`. The resampling identities `avgOver_aLinePointDist_resample_parameter`, `avgOver_dLinePointDist_resample_parameter` and `avgOver_linePointDist_resample_parameter` are the correct conditional-sampling rewriting for the equal mixture of `def:line-point-dist` (`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`, verified). The collision event stays non-vacuous: on a nonzero direction both `evalOpt` values are `some (evalCoefficient _ param)`, so the indicator is a genuine coefficient collision, and the `direction != 0` restriction is applied to both sides of the inequality rather than only to the left, so the bound is not weakened into triviality. The shape `weight` on the first line and the full second sample, collision on the first sample matches the hypothesis of `lem:pasting` at `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525` ("on average over `y_2` ... conditioned on `(x,y_1)`"), and `bound / |ScalarQ L|` matches the `eta = md/q` instantiation at `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:950-955` (verified in the mirror). All four locators cited in the new docstrings, plus `eq:cl-dlnf` at `08_...:230-237`, resolve to what the docstrings claim. These declarations are labelled formalization-only support and do not restate a paper theorem, so the restriction to nondegenerate directions is a documented boundary, not source drift; the zero-direction fibers of the mixture will still have to be handled where `lem:qld-xz-lines` is finally assembled.

Proof integrity. No `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, `native_decide` or unsafe cast in any of the twelve changed or added Lean files (the single `sorry` at `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines.lean:79` is inherited, untouched by this diff, which only adds imports there). `lake env lean` passed silently on `Lines/ProductWeightedCollision.lean`, `Lines/WeightedCollision.lean` and `Lines/ConsistencyPositivity.lean` in the PR worktree. Exact-head CI is green: `local-ci/summary` "all gating steps passed (969s)", with build, blueprint-render, blueprint-sync, paper-gaps, file-length, proof-debt and proof-evasion all success. The `ConsistencyPositivity` refactor deletes three private copies and derives `place_mul_place_nonneg` from main's `place_comm` / `place_nonneg` (`Points/PlacementSupport.lean:217,172`) and `offDiagonalPlacedProduct_nonneg` from `place_finsetSum` (`:140`); the three public statements are unchanged, so this is reuse, not restatement.

Prior findings. Review 5156186557 raised one finding (duplicated `hresample` in `AxisLineResampling`/`DiagonalResampling`); it is resolved at this head by the shared lemma in `SubLineUniform.lean`, and both proofs call it. Review 5185496775 left no open finding. F1 and F2 above are new, and are consequences of main advancing past the merge base: main has since landed equivalent modules under different names, and GitHub reports this head as `mergeable: false` (`mergeable_state: dirty`) against main `92b252ed`, so a refresh onto main is required anyway and is where both duplicates must be removed.

Prose. The one prose change is `lem:line-representative-resampling` at `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:874-893`. Its hypotheses (finite field `K`, `m`, `v`, arbitrary `F`), its conclusion (`E_u F(r_v(u),u) = E_u E_t F(r_v(u), r_v(u)+tv)`) and its expectation order match the Lean signature; `\uses{def:line-representative}` resolves to `ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:500`; both `\leanok` tags sit on a statement and a proof that are genuinely `sorry`-free at this head; the two-step proof sketch is correct and includes the `v = 0` case. The only prose consequence of F2 is retargeting the `\lean{...}` line, so I rate prose approved and leave the edit inside F2.

Not checked: no full `lake build` (the machine-wide lock belongs to the gate); the 111-line `results/telemetry/events.md` append was read only for merge artifacts (none, and `git diff --check` is clean); main's `evalCoefficient_collision_card_le` and `PlacementSupport` lemmas were read but not re-verified; downstream consumers of the new collision estimate do not exist yet, so its usability for the final `lem:qld-xz-lines` assembly is untested. Non-blocking note: commit subjects `Add weighted line collision bound` (7e28563a) and `Add mixed line parameter resampling` (546f0a1b) do not follow the `type(scope): short description` convention; a squash merge normalizes this and I did not raise it as a finding, since rewriting the published branch history is not available to the fix lane.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED (code=CHANGES_REQUESTED, prose=APPROVED)

# Review - PR 456 @ e8a6923847e01b75adca9a8afd2e97e866aba2b3

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 92b252ed4bb1860b12a0a6c96084512f53ae9e10. Small, focused change (9 files, +427/-86): two new Lean modules for axis and mixed line-point parameter resampling, one extracted shared helper, and the blueprint entries that record them together with a seed-bearing/source notation split in chapters 13 and 15.

## Findings

- none

## Review

Scope reviewed: merge base `13409f63dea11a0e8a2f5d336215175448d4fccd`, full main-relative diff of all nine changed files read in full, plus the surrounding context of every touched declaration (`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines.lean`, `Lines/AxisLineResampling.lean`, `Lines/DiagonalResampling.lean`, `Lines/MixedResampling.lean`, `Lines/RestrictedMixture.lean`, `Lines/SubLinePrefix.lean`, `Lines/SubLineUniform.lean`, `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex`, `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex`). The worktree HEAD equals the published head, so the published head is what was read.

Prior findings. Round 1 (review 5148574797) code F1-F3 and round 2 (5151788131) prose F1-F4 were already confirmed resolved at round 3; I re-checked the three that round 3 (5155066497) left unresolved and all three are resolved at this head. Prose F1 (seed-retaining vs source laws): `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:180-201` now names $\widetilde D_{\mathsf{ALine}}, \widetilde D_{\mathsf{DLine}}, \widetilde D_{\mathsf{Line}}$, defines the forgetful maps $\rho_{\mathsf{ALine}}, \rho_{\mathsf{DLine}}$ and states the push-forward identities, and `ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1300-1307`, `:1313-1340`, `:1343-1368`, `:1428-1490` use the tilded symbols consistently; the Lean side genuinely carries the seeds (`LineDesc.axis` takes the seed as `block.1` in `AxisLineResampling.lean:47-56`), so the two sides now describe laws on the same sample space. Prose F2 (index base): the zero-based convention and its one-based translation are stated at `ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1305-1307` and repeated in `def:ith-restricted-line`. Prose F3 (dependency tags): the corollary proof at `ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:942-943` now lists `lem:uniform-map-equivalence` and `lem:line-representative-idempotent`, and the fixed-direction proof at `:894` lists the idempotence lemma; both match what the Lean proofs call (`uniformDistribution_map_equiv`, `lineRepMap_apply_self`).

Code. No `sorry`, `axiom`, `admit` or `native_decide` in any file touched by this diff; the single `sorry` at `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines.lean:74` is the pre-existing combined-line construction and is untouched. No new hypothesis was added to any declaration: the three resampling theorems quantify over an arbitrary real-valued `value` on line-point pairs and are therefore not vacuous, and `restricted_lines_consistency_bound` keeps its universal constant existentially quantified outside every strategy and parameter binder, with `C = 4` matching the paper factor `4m^2` at `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1049-1061`. The round-1 duplication is properly removed rather than re-hidden: the local `hresample` block is deleted from `DiagonalResampling.lean` and both samplers now call the new shared `avgOver_lineRepMap_resample_parameter` (`SubLineUniform.lean:128-145`), which has no counterpart on `github/main`, and its proof reuses the existing `avgOver_uniform_prod` from `MIPStarRE/LDT/Basic/DistributionAvg.lean:630` instead of re-deriving the product average. `AxisLineResampling.lean` mirrors `DiagonalResampling.lean` in imports, namespace and module-docstring shape; both new modules carry a `## References` section, and every new declaration has a docstring with a resolvable paper locator, which I checked against the sources: `08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287` is indeed `def:line-point-dist`, and `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:950-955` is the pasting/Schwartz-Zippel step the resampling feeds.

Prose. `thm:direct-sub-line-distribution` is the right shape for `exists_subLineWitness`: `lem:qld-sublines` correctly loses its `\lean{...}` links and stays `\notready`, and the new auxiliary theorem opens by disclaiming that it is the source statement and closes by recording that transport to the seed-indexed carrier is unresolved. Its item 3 matches the Lean field exactly, including the detail that a single kind `v` is shared by the X and Z factors (`Witnesses.lean:180-199` builds both `subLineXComponentDist` and `subLineZComponentDist` from `component.1`) and that only the two separate marginals, not a joint conditional law, are asserted. `lem:restricted-line-mixture-bounds` now states the two component-level mixture identities that `linePointDist_eq_mixture_restricted` (`Lines.lean:180-187`) actually proves, and the nonnegativity hypothesis of `avg_restricted_le` is stated in the blueprint text. Splitting `eq:qld-xz-lines-restricted` out into the new `lem:restricted-line-consistency-bound`, which names the given point and line measurements, is more honest than leaving it as item 3 of the mixture lemma, and the label is not duplicated. `\uses` edges in the new proofs list only what the Lean proofs call.

One observation, not a finding, for a later pass: the newly added source push-forward sentences sit inside environments carrying `\leanok` while no linked Lean declaration states them - the second display at `ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:931-935` and the closing proof sentence at `:948-950`, the trailing sentence at `:1367-1368`, the conditional sentence at `:1412-1415`, and the sentence at `:1478-1480`. I verified each of these push-forward claims is mathematically correct ($\rho$ preserves base and direction, and push-forward commutes with mixtures and with products), and the corollary explicitly tells the reader which identity the linked declarations prove, which satisfies `docs/blueprint_style_guide.md:69-76`; the pre-existing `ch13` sentence on `github/main` already used the same convention. Formalizing them, or moving them into remarks, would make the markers exact.

Also non-blocking: commit `546f0a1b` has the subject "Add mixed line parameter resampling", which lacks the `type(scope):` prefix required by `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md` section 3; history rewriting is not available to a reviewer, and a squash merge with a conforming title resolves it.

Verified myself: `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/MixedResampling.lean` and `.../SubLineUniform.lean` both elaborate with no diagnostics in the worktree at this head; `git grep` for proof holes over all seven changed Lean files; exact-head CI `gh api repos/Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-A/commits/e8a6923847e01b75adca9a8afd2e97e866aba2b3/status` reports `local-ci/summary` success with all nine gating contexts green (build, blueprint-render, paper-gaps, blueprint-sync, file-length, proof-debt, proof-evasion, statement-origin skipped). The only failing context is `local-review/summary` ("code reviewer exited 143 with no review"), which is the review lane this review replaces.

Not checked: no full `lake build` and no `leanblueprint web` rerun (CI supplies both at this head); no `#print axioms` audit of my own (prior rounds recorded clean closures for these declarations and nothing in this diff introduces a new dependency on the open `sorry`); the `lean-conventions` external reference was not available and was not relied on; the still-open transport from the directly indexed carrier to the seed-indexed source law is out of scope for this PR and is not claimed by it.

VERDICT: APPROVED (code=APPROVED, prose=APPROVED)
